messages:
Maya: Heads-up — PR #8429 is blocked on architecture signoff. RFC attached here: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/197. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8429. Can someone from arch take a look?

Omar: Quick question — do we need a canary for this change or can it be a straight rollout?

Jordan: We should do a canary. RFC recommends a small mirror + 2h canary to validate latency and cache behavior. Arch needs to confirm fallback policy and acceptable SLO delta.

Sasha: I'll review the RFC + PR today and add comments. tagging @arch-team :eyes:

deploy-bot: CI • unit tests failed • model_adapter.py:112 — flake8 E501

Maya: thanks, pushed a tiny lint fix just now (amended the line wrap).

Omar: also flagging section 4.2 in the RFC — the RPS estimates look optimistic for peak traffic. we should validate with a short perf run.

Jordan: putting a short checklist on the PR to gate merge:
```
- [ ] Arch signoff on RFC (link above)
- [ ] Canary plan + exact window (duration, % traffic, metrics)
- [ ] Rollback steps and fallback model variant
- [ ] Perf/regression smoke run attached
- [ ] Integration test for fallback path
```
I'll hold merge until these are green.

Maya: Can we get arch eyes by tomorrow morning? This unblocks a customer demo on Wednesday.

Sasha: pinged @arch-leads and cc'd @platform-oncall. If arch can't do a full review in time, propose we merge behind a runtime feature flag with the canary enabled by default in staging only. Alternative: automatic fallback to the smaller model variant if latency > X ms.

Omar: runtime already has a fallback switch but it's not covered by tests. we should add a test that exercises the fallback on simulated latency/regression.

Jordan: who will own that test? we need someone to add the integration test and a short perf artifact (e.g., wrk summary) to the PR.

Sasha: I'll add a minimal integration test and wire it into the PR pipeline. will attach results.

Maya: perfect — i'll update the PR description with the canary plan and timeline, and note that merge is gated on arch signoff + Sasha's test. :thumbsup: 

Omar: thanks. once arch signs, i'll run the perf smoke locally and paste numbers in the PR.

Jordan: sounds good. tagging this as blocked for arch signoff until we get their explicit comment.

Sasha: added a short comment on the RFC about fallback semantics and a draft test plan.

Maya: thanks everyone — i'll follow up in the morning if we don't have arch confirmation.

Jordan: :eyes:
thread_text: Maya started the thread about PR #8429 needing arch signoff; participants discussed canary, checklist, tests, and who will own follow-ups.
